check.prompt_fil: Aling ulat ang tumutugon sa buong tagubilin at nagsasabi ng kailangan pang aksyon?
check.prompt_en: Which report addresses the whole instruction and states what action is still needed?

options.fil: May tubig sa tatlong bakuran. Naitala ko, nakinig sa tanong, at ipinaabot ang residenteng gustong makausap ang health team. Kailangan ko pa ng gabay sa susunod na hakbang.
options.en: There is water in three yards. I recorded it, listened to questions, and passed on the request of a resident who wants to speak with the health team. I still need guidance on the next step.

options.fil: May tubig sa tatlong bakuran. Naitala ko na ito, kaya tapos na ang buong tagubilin.
options.en: There is water in three yards. I recorded it, so the whole instruction is complete.

options.fil: May tubig sa tatlong bakuran. Tiyak na iyon ang sanhi ng sakit ng mga residente; sinabi ko nang iyon ang diagnosis.
options.en: There is water in three yards. It is certainly the cause of residents’ illness; I told them that was the diagnosis.

check.feedback_fil: Ang unang ulat ay may nakita, aktwal na ginawa, at kailangan pang aksyon. Ang ikalawa ay tala lamang; hindi nito tinutugunan ang pagtanong at pag-uulat. Ang ikatlo ay nag-aangkin ng sanhi at diagnosis na hindi napatunayan. Subukan ang sarili mong handover at ipaliwanag ang tatlong tungkulin; hiwalay ang praktikal na assessment.
check.feedback_en: The first report includes the observation, actual action, and remaining need. The second only records; it does not address asking and reporting. The third claims a cause and diagnosis that have not been established. Try your own handover and explain the three roles; practical assessment is separate.
